baseline: run 18 snow. Footprint LOD is diagnostic only. Default sampling is unchanged.
lod: log2(minorTexels) + k * clamp(log2(major/minor) - 1, 0, 2), then 8 taps along the major axis
sharpness: mean absolute Laplacian on y 0.82-0.96, Bolt masked, divided by the baseline at the same time. A drop past 10% would fail.
reading: The three k values render the same pixels. The bias term is zero: after the derivative floor, major/minor stays at or under 2, so clamp(log2(r)-1, 0, 2) is 0. The minor-axis 8-tap is sharper than the run 18 fetch (near ground at t=8 is 1.28-1.30 of the baseline, not a blur) and it does not move the spikes. 5.10, 5.567, and 11.70 stay over 1.8. No k is applied. No chase.
